### 新产品
1. **OpenShell: NVIDIA's open-source sandbox runtime that lets agents work without unrestricted access**: Apache-2.0 runtime for fleets of autonomous agents — each agent runs in an isolated sandbox with kernel-level enforcement of file, syscall and network policy; real credentials never enter the sandbox and are injected only onto requests bound for approved endpoints. Policy changes are formally verified before apply so risky new hosts or API methods wait for human review. Install with one curl script; needs Linux, Apple Silicon macOS, or Windows WSL2 plus Docker/Podman. Docs and a 0.1.x upgrade guide are up; ~19k GitHub stars and trending overnight. https://docs.nvidia.com/openshell/latest/ [GitHub](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell)
> **[zh]** **OpenShell：NVIDIA 开源的沙箱运行时，让 Agent 能干活却拿不到无限制权限**：Apache-2.0，面向大规模自治 Agent——每个 Agent 跑在隔离沙箱里，内核层强制文件、系统调用和网络策略；真实凭证不进沙箱，只在发往已批准端点的请求上注入。策略变更上线前会做形式化验证，新主机或新 API 方法要等人工审。一条 curl 安装；需 Linux、Apple Silicon macOS 或 Windows WSL2，外加 Docker/Podman。文档和 0.1.x 升级指南已上线；GitHub 约 1.9 万星，夜间登上趋势。
2. **Impeccable: design vocabulary for AI coding agents — 1 skill, 24 commands, 62 detector rules**: install with `npx impeccable install`, then `/impeccable init` writes durable product truth into `PRODUCT.md`. Commands cover craft, audit, critique, polish, distill, animate, live browser iteration and more; the CLI and browser extension run 62 deterministic anti-slop detectors with no LLM or API key. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and others. Site: impeccable.style; ~86k GitHub stars. https://impeccable.style [GitHub](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable)
> **[zh]** **Impeccable：给 AI 编程 Agent 用的设计词汇——1 个 skill、24 条命令、62 条检测规则**：`npx impeccable install` 安装，再跑 `/impeccable init` 把产品事实写入 `PRODUCT.md`。命令覆盖 craft、audit、critique、polish、distill、animate、浏览器里实时迭代等；CLI 和浏览器扩展可零 LLM、零 API key 跑 62 条确定性「反 AI 审美垃圾」检测。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等。官网 impeccable.style；GitHub 约 8.6 万星。
3. **Perch: a calm Mac home for Claude Code sessions, PRs and next steps**: free beta for Apple Silicon — bring existing Claude Code sessions over, see every session/PR/link in one place, and get notified only when Claude, a reviewer or CI is waiting on you. Contexts and notes stay in a local database (no Perch account or servers); GitHub via your `gh` login; Claude talks to Anthropic the same way as without Perch. Quit or update and sessions keep running. https://perchfocus.com [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50225233)
> **[zh]** **Perch：给 Claude Code 会话、PR 和下一步用的安静 Mac 工作台**：Apple Silicon 免费 beta——把已有 Claude Code 会话迁过来，所有会话/PR/链接一处看清，只在 Claude、审阅人或 CI 等你时提醒。上下文和笔记存在本地库（无 Perch 账号或服务器）；GitHub 走你自己的 `gh` 登录；Claude 连 Anthropic 的方式和不用 Perch 时一样。退出或更新后会话继续跑。
4. **Scrawl: show an agent the problem on your screen — talk, click, draw, paste**: Mac app (Homebrew cask / zip; Windows preview) — press ⌥⇧S, narrate and annotate while it records frames only when you draw, click, say “look”/“now”, or the screen changes; each sentence sticks to its frame, cropped to the window you worked in. Paste into your agent; `bunx skills add kitlangton/scrawl` teaches agents to read the contact sheet and zoom in. Can mirror an iPhone screen or embed ScrawlKit in an iOS app. https://scrawl.kitlangton.com [GitHub](https://github.com/kitlangton/scrawl) [Lobsters](https://lobste.rs/s/jqjioq)
> **[zh]** **Scrawl：把屏幕上的问题展示给 Agent——边说边点边画，再粘贴过去**：Mac 应用（Homebrew cask / zip；Windows 预览）——按 ⌥⇧S，边讲解边标注；只在你画、点、说「look」/「now」或画面变化时截帧，每句话贴在对应帧上，并裁到你操作的窗口。粘贴给 Agent；`bunx skills add kitlangton/scrawl` 可教 Agent 读联系表并放大细看。可镜像 iPhone 屏幕，或把 ScrawlKit 嵌进 iOS 应用。
5. **ADRs for AI: keep the “why” of human–AI decisions as versioned records in Git**: starter repo with ADR/seed templates, inbox protocol and task-runner recipes; VS Code/Open VSX extension with tree views, diagnostics and an MCP server so agents can query the record; iOS client for reviewing open questions and one-tap Accept that lands answers as commits. 2. **Keycloak unauthenticated account takeover gets a public exploit (CVE-2026-18963)**: a flaw in the reset-credentials flow lets an unauthenticated attacker force a password reset for any user without the emailed verification link, then set new credentials. Red Hat rates CVSS 9.1; fixes shipped in August (26.4.15 / 26.6.6 / 26.7.2). On Oct 21 Exploit-DB published a full PoC (EDB-52699) with check and takeover modes — unpatched instances should upgrade now. https://pwn.watch/i/keycloak-cve-2026-18963-reset-credentials-takeover
> **[zh]** **Keycloak 未认证账号接管漏洞已有公开利用（CVE-2026-18963）**：重置凭证流程的缺陷让未认证攻击者可在不点邮件验证链接的情况下，强制任意用户重置密码并写入新凭证。Red Hat 评 CVSS 9.1；修复已在 8 月放出（26.4.15 / 26.6.6 / 26.7.2）。10 月 21 日 Exploit-DB 发布完整 PoC（EDB-52699，含检测与接管模式）——未打补丁的实例应立刻升级。
3. **Okta Access Gateway: admin-console RCE plus auth-source bypass (CVE-2026-115547 / 115546)**: Okta fixed two on-prem OAG bugs on Oct 22 — CVE-2026-115547 (CVSS 9.1) lets an authenticated admin run system commands as the OAG service account via crafted config values; CVE-2026-115546 (CVSS 8.1) lets any user with a valid session change the authentication-source parameter at sign-on and get a SAML assertion for the Admin Console. Combined, a regular gateway user could potentially reach command execution. Fixed in 2026.10.2; OAG's bundled PHP also got PHP2Shell fixes in 2026.44.0. Okta cloud is unaffected. https://pwn.watch/i/okta-access-gateway-cve-2026-115547-115546
> **[zh]** **Okta Access Gateway：管理控制台命令执行 + 认证源绕过（CVE-2026-115547 / 115546）**：Okta 10 月 22 日修复两个本地部署 OAG 漏洞——CVE-2026-115547（CVSS 9.1）让已认证管理员通过特制配置值以 OAG 服务账号跑系统命令；CVE-2026-115546（CVSS 8.1）让任意有效会话用户在登录时改认证源参数，拿到管理控制台的 SAML 断言。合在一起，普通网关用户或可达命令执行。修复版本 2026.10.2；自带 PHP 的 PHP2Shell 补丁在 2026.44.0。Okta 云端不受影响。
4. **The Goose Programming Language: memory-safe systems language with no heap, GC, or lifetime annotations**: by Wouter van Oortmerssen — every dynamic value lives inline on compiler-managed data stacks; growth is a pointer bump and memory frees when its scope ends. Claims faster than C++/Rust with less memory on its own benchmarks; syntax familiar to C/Rust programmers, with stable references that survive growth and no annotation-heavy borrow checker. John Carmack linked it; ~237 points and 160 comments on HN. https://aardappel.github.io/goose/ [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50224100)
> **[zh]** **Goose 编程语言：无堆、无 GC、无生命周期标注的内存安全系统语言**：Wouter van Oortmerssen 之作——动态值都内联放在编译器管理的数据栈上，增长只是指针前移，作用域结束即释放。自有基准上声称比 C++/Rust 更快、更省内存；语法接近 C/Rust，引用在增长后仍稳定，也没有标注繁重的借用检查。John Carmack 转发；HN 约 237 分、160 条评论。

> **[en]** **InfoQ: AI agents are rewriting the value of CPUs — the compute race is no longer just about GPUs**: Arm cloud AI architect Ravi Malhotra argues agent workloads flip between “reason/plan” and “tool call/orchestrate”, so CPUs must turn tokens into actions, feed inference, and handle workflow orchestration plus sandbox isolation — a fast GPU still idles behind a slow CPU. Software-engineering agents need per-task speed; enterprise automation and personal assistants need high-concurrency throughput. Signal65 reported ~2× rack-level performance for Arm AGI CPUs under the same power budget vs a comparison platform (sponsored study; real deployments still need validation). The industry still lacks a shared Agent-CPU benchmark.

The agent first does a read-only inventory of Dockerfiles, base images, distro packages, CI, Helm and Terraform, changes nothing until you approve, verifies target versions/digests/checksums, runs tests before and after in the new image, and opens one PR per repo with a risk label and rollback plan. Works in Devin, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and others; there is no published fix-rate benchmark, so it is only as good as your tests. Note distro packages (Debian/Ubuntu) backport fixes without changing `php -v`. https://x.com/Marktechpost/status/2114190379696476657 | https://devin.ai/blog/vulnerability-fixes-plugin | https://github.com/CognitionAI/devin-vuln-fixes
> **[zh]** **Cognition 开源 Devin Vulnerability Fixes：用 agent skill 修补本周 PHP、Node.js、GitLab 的 RCE**：三个 MIT 协议的 SKILL.md（`fix-php-vuln`、`fix-node-vuln`、`fix-gitlab-vuln`），覆盖 PHP2Shell（CVSS v4 9.2）、10 月 21 日 Node.js 安全版本（10 个 CVE）和自托管 GitLab CVE-2026-110264（CVSS 10.0）。Agent 先只读盘点 Dockerfile、基础镜像、发行版包、CI、Helm 和 Terraform，你批准前不改任何东西；校验目标版本、镜像 digest 和校验和，在新镜像里跑前后测试，每个仓库开一条带风险标签和回滚方案的 PR。Devin、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等都能用；没有公开修复率基准，效果取决于你的测试。注意 Debian/Ubuntu 的发行版包回移补丁后 `php -v` 版本号不变。

### 有趣用法和干货
1. **Strata：让普通游戏电脑本地跑 125B 级大模型，并接入 Claude Code / Codex**：开源推理引擎（MIT，GitHub 约 3.2 万星），用 GPU 显存、内存和 SSD 三级调度加 MoE 专家动态缓存，显存加内存合计 32GB 起步就能跑 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，0.2.4 起还能在终端跑 DeepSeek V4.1-Flash；支持 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon，提供兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的本地 API，Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode 可直接接。帖子称 RTX 5070 跑 Q2 量化约 94 token/s、推测解码提速 1.6–1.8 倍；需约 80GB SSD 空间。https://x.com/wiksongkim/status/2114167999838220425 ｜ https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata
> **[en]** **Strata: run a 125B-class model locally on a gaming PC and wire it into Claude Code / Codex**: an open-source inference engine (MIT, ~32k GitHub stars) that tiers VRAM, RAM and SSD with dynamic MoE expert caching, so 32 GB of combined RAM + VRAM is enough to start Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and from 0.2.4 DeepSeek V4.1-Flash in the terminal; supports NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon and exposes local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs so Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode connect directly. The post cites ~94 tok/s for a Q2 quant on an RTX 5070 and 1.6–1.8x from speculative decoding; needs ~80 GB of SSD.
2. **李继刚：辅导孩子学诗词的「文字成画」Prompt**：让模型把一首诗变成只由诗中文字组成的图，字的位置和走向就是画面。四步：找事实（只写诗里有的意象和上下、垂落、动向关系）→ 定投影（意象由指称它的字构成，垂下就沿弧线排、高就竖着叠、风就斜穿；「不知」「谁」「似」这类字放在留白或意象交界处）→ 出图 → 逐条自检（所有字出自原诗、不看原诗也认得出画面、沿路径能一字不差读出全诗、不拿别的字凑）。末尾留 `诗：{在这里放诗}` 占位，结构清楚、带验收标准，也适合改成其他图文任务。https://x.com/lijigang/status/2114206178939146352
> **[en]** **Li Jigang: a "poem-as-picture" prompt for helping kids learn classical poetry**: the model turns a poem into an image made only of the poem's characters, where their placement and direction form the picture. Four steps: gather facts (only the poem's images and their relations — above, hanging, moving which way) → project (each image is built from the characters that name it; hanging means an arc downward, tall means stacked vertically, wind means a diagonal sweep; words like "不知/谁/似" go in blank space or at the seams) → render → self-check (every character comes from the poem, the scene is recognizable without the text, the poem can be read verbatim along a path, no filler characters). Ends with a `诗：{...}` slot; the step-plus-acceptance-criteria structure transfers to other text-image tasks.
3. **Agent Manager (Hugging Face, @lvwerra): run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode and more side by side from your own private HF Space**: an Apache-2.0 Docker Space template described as a "private cloud manager for AI coding CLI sessions" — duplicate it and you get a browser UI for parallel agent sessions in the cloud. Heads-up from the poster: the app has no login of its own, so keep the Space and its storage bucket private. https://x.com/haginota/status/2114177694678331633 | https://huggingface.co/spaces/lvwerra/agent-manager-template
> **[zh]** **Agent Manager（Hugging Face，@lvwerra）：在自己的私有 HF Space 里并排跑 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、opencode 等**：Apache-2.0 的 Docker Space 模板，自述为「AI 编程 CLI 会话的私有云管理器」，复制一份就有一个浏览器界面，在云上并行开多个 agent 会话。发帖人提醒：应用本身没有登录，Space 和存储桶一定要设成私有。
4. **tualatrix：Claude Max 被封后，自己的 Agent 工具让他几乎零成本换号续上**：他只通过 API、命令行或 SDK 用各家 Agent 服务，会话资料都在本地自己管，所以被封当天就能新开账号或换其他模型接着干（效果会有差别）。他还演示了用 Grok Bot 每 15 分钟扫一遍回复区，疑似 AI 回复就拉出该账号最近 10 条回复整理成表，人只做「隐藏+屏蔽」的决定，决策写入审计表后再由 Bot 执行。https://x.com/tualatrix/status/2114184396299510120 ｜ https://x.com/tualatrix/status/2114220429938499719
> **[en]** **tualatrix: after his Claude Max account was banned, his own agent tooling let him switch with almost no friction**: he only uses agent services through APIs, CLIs or SDKs and keeps all session data locally, so he could open a new account or move to another model the same day (with different results). He also demoed Grok Bot scanning his replies every 15 minutes, pulling a suspected AI-reply account's last 10 replies into a table; he only makes the hide-and-block call, which is logged to an audit sheet before the bot executes it.

REA itself isn't blocked, and source-code review and patching are fine. If answers suddenly feel worse, check which model labeled the reply, turn off automatic switching for a clean stop, edit the triggering message before retrying, and security professionals can apply to the Cyber Verification Program for fewer blocks. https://x.com/lenny_enderle/status/2114308841135386852 | https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16049681-why-claude-switched-models-in-your-conversation-with-opus-5-or-opus-5-5 | https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842-cyber-verification-program

> **[en]** **x-reader: make your agent say exactly what it actually read from a link**: an open-source content reader covering 10+ platforms including X, YouTube, Bilibili, WeChat articles, Xiaohongshu and podcasts. It labels which layer it got: a search snippet isn't the original, a post caption isn't the video, a video description isn't what was said; a missing layer is marked "partially read", and a failure is reported as a failure. Bilibili goes through subtitles and audio transcription, YouTube falls back to speech-to-text without captions; paste the one-liner from the repo into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor and the agent installs and self-tests it. > **[zh]** **Nanbeige4.3-33B：BOSS直聘开源的 Agent 模型，30B 档 Agent 编程和办公任务领先**：Nanbeige 团队（看准网）把它定位为 4.3 系列的旗舰「教师模型」，后续还会蒸馏出 3B 小模型。在最高思考强度下对比 Qwen3.8-27B、Muse-Glimmer-30B、Gemma4-31B：Terminal-Bench 2.1 拿 80.9（Qwen 73.0），DeepSWE 65.5（42.5），Automation Bench 54.2，SWE-Bench Pro 60.3（Qwen 61.7）；512K 上下文，Agent 循环建议开 `preserve_thinking`，支持 Transformers/SGLang/vLLM。今晚在 LinuxDo 被分享。
2. **Indra OCR: Datalab's ~1M-parameter OCR model that runs on CPU and beats PaddleOCR's full pipeline**: `pip install indra-ocr` turns PDFs and images into markdown, text or JSON with boxes, layout labels and reading order; ONNX Runtime only, no PyTorch or GPU, ~76 MB of models. Scores 66.7 on OmniParseBench (71.4 with `--math`) vs 58.4 for PP-StructureV3, at ~44 pages/s on 32 cores (15x Tesseract) and ~210 ms/page on 4 cores; 80+ languages incl. CJK and vertical text, weak on handwriting and complex tables. Code Apache 2.0, weights modified OpenRAIL-M; trending on Hugging Face. https://www.datalab.to/ [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datalab-to/indra-ocr)
> **[zh]** **Indra OCR：Datalab 的约 100 万参数 OCR 模型，纯 CPU 跑，还胜过 PaddleOCR 整套流水线**：`pip install indra-ocr` 即可把 PDF 和图片转成 markdown、纯文本或带框选、版面标签和阅读顺序的 JSON；只依赖 ONNX Runtime，不要 PyTorch 和 GPU，模型约 76 MB。OmniParseBench 66.7 分（开 `--math` 71.4），PP-StructureV3 为 58.4；32 核约每秒 44 页（Tesseract 的 15 倍），4 核约 210 毫秒一页；支持 80 多种语言含中日韩和竖排，手写和复杂表格较弱。代码 Apache 2.0，权重为修改版 OpenRAIL-M；正登上 Hugging Face 趋势榜。
3. **AgentGrid.io: a shared workspace where humans and agents work on the same live artifacts**: YC-backed; docs, reports, slides, apps and designs that Claude, GPT, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw and other agents can edit together with people, with shared context, controlled access and full version history. Free tier; #3 on Product Hunt today. https://agentgrid.io [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/agentgrid-io)
> **[zh]** **AgentGrid.io：人和 Agent 在同一份实时产物上协作的共享工作区**：YC 投资；文档、报告、幻灯片、应用和设计稿都能让 Claude、GPT、Codex、Cursor、Hermes、OpenClaw 等 Agent 和人一起编辑，共享上下文、权限可控、完整版本历史。有免费档；今天 Product Hunt 第 3。
4. **Papermark Data Rooms 2.0: an open-source data room your AI agents can run via API, CLI and MCP**: spin up an encrypted, white-labeled M&A/fundraising data room in under 60 seconds, with file permissions, built-in Q&A, full audit log and page-by-page analytics; ask Claude or Cursor for "a buy-side M&A room for Project Atlas" and get folders, permissions and a share link back. Hosted or self-hosted; makers say 80k+ users. https://www.papermark.com/data-room [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/papermark-2)
> **[zh]** **Papermark Data Rooms 2.0：可让 AI Agent 通过 API、CLI 和 MCP 操作的开源数据室**：60 秒内建好加密、可白标的并购/融资数据室，带文件权限、内置问答、完整审计日志和逐页阅读分析；对 Claude 或 Cursor 说「给 Project Atlas 建个买方并购数据室」，就能拿回目录、权限和分享链接。可托管也可自建；团队称已有 8 万多用户。
5. **TiboSay（Tibo 说）：致敬 cowsay 的 Codex 额度重置监控与预测站**：V2EX 分享创造新作，自动归档 @thsottiaux 每次重置推文（标出全员重置/储备重置），给出累计次数、平均间隔、最长等待和重置热力图；「AI 预测」按距上次重置的间隔、美西作息和 28 天挑战节奏算 24 小时重置概率和预计时间窗，终端里 `npx tibosay` 可看 ASCII 小人播报，还附「求重置」按钮和小游戏。https://tibosay.com/zh [V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1251631)
> **[en]** **TiboSay: a cowsay-style Codex usage-reset tracker and predictor**: new on V2EX's Share & Create — it auto-archives every @thsottiaux reset post (tagged full vs banked reset), shows total count, average interval, longest wait and a reset heatmap; an "AI prediction" combines time since the last reset, Pacific-time habits and the 28-day challenge cadence into a 24-hour reset probability and expected window; `npx tibosay` prints an ASCII status in the terminal, plus a "pray for reset" button and mini-games.

### 科技新闻
1. **Cerebras explains how it serves trillion-parameter models at 1,000–2,000+ tokens/s**: using open-source Kimi K3 (~3T params, 69 linear-attention + 24 dense layers) as the example: at 4-bit weights each layer is ~16 GB, so a 44 GB WSE-3T wafer holds two linear layers or one dense layer plus its KV cache — 59 wafers total. Weights never move; only activations hop between wafers over RDMA (~2 µs per hop), and the pipeline stays full with many micro-batched requests in flight, so on-chip KV memory caps concurrency. Useful context now that OpenAI runs SOTA models on Cerebras; ~224 points on HN. https://www.cerebras.ai/blog/how-we-deploy-trillion-parameter-frontier-models-on-cerebras [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50227356)
> **[zh]** **Cerebras 讲解如何以每秒 1000–2000+ token 跑万亿参数模型**：以开源 Kimi K3（约 3T 参数，69 层线性注意力 + 24 层稠密层）为例：4-bit 权重下每层约 16 GB，一片 44 GB 的 WSE-3T 晶圆放两层线性层，或一层稠密层加它的 KV 缓存——共 59 片晶圆。权重不动，只有激活值通过 RDMA 在晶圆间传递（每跳约 2 微秒）；流水线里同时跑大量微批请求，因此片上 KV 内存决定并发上限。OpenAI 已把 SOTA 模型放上 Cerebras，这篇是很好的背景；HN 约 224 分。
2. **Dan Luu: "We should be more ambitious with the software we build"**: with agents, things that used to be absurd side quests now take hours — he built a regex engine and ripgrep fork tuned to his Codex workloads, and a Rust interpreter with ~50x faster cold builds, mostly because a 10–100x faster model makes ripgrep, Rust compiles and filesystem syscalls the bottleneck. GPT-6 Astra passes zstd's tests >99% of the time for about $1, so he moved his evals to IMAP and Pandoc; he argues most programmers still carry a "pre-agentic cost model", and includes Yossi Kreinin's rebuttal that most people should be less ambitious. ~514 points and 450+ comments on HN. https://danluu.com/ambitious/ [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50225695)
> **[zh]** **Dan Luu：「我们做软件应该更有野心」**：有了 Agent，过去荒唐的支线项目现在几小时就能做完——他做了针对自己 Codex 负载调优的正则引擎和 ripgrep 分支，以及冷编译快约 50 倍的 Rust 解释器，起因是模型快 10–100 倍后，ripgrep、Rust 编译和文件系统调用会成为瓶颈。GPT-6 Astra 实现 zstd 通过测试的概率超 99%，成本约 1 美元，他只好把评测换成 IMAP 和 Pandoc；他认为多数程序员还带着「Agent 之前的成本模型」，文中也附上 Yossi Kreinin 的反驳：大多数人反而该少些野心。HN 约 514 分、450 多条评论。
3. **三星电视被曝用 AI 分析截屏和音频做精准广告**：IT之家援引 Tom's Hardware，安全研究员逆向 2025 款三星电视发现，Tizen 系统会大量处理音频、屏幕截图和广告标识符，并跑卷积神经网络分析用户看了什么、跳过哪些广告；没有麦克风时还会找条形音箱、蓝牙设备的麦克风录音。HN 上相关帖称它在 960×540 截图上跑 TensorFlow Lite 模型，约 110 分。https://www.ithome.com/1/017/670.htm [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50230181)
> **[en]** **Samsung TVs reportedly use AI on screenshots and audio for targeted ads**: IT Home, citing Tom's Hardware, says a security researcher reverse-engineered a 2025 Samsung TV and found Tizen heavily processing audio, screenshots and the ad ID, running a CNN to analyze what you watch and which ads you skip; without a built-in mic it looks for soundbar or Bluetooth device mics. The HN thread says it runs a TensorFlow Lite model on 960×540 frames; ~110 points.
4. **Electrum wallet: malicious servers swap just-sent transactions so a fee bump pays the attacker**: Electrum before 4.8.3 trusted its server for unconfirmed transactions without checking signatures; a malicious server hides the real broadcast and shows a fake one paying an attacker address ground to match the last four characters, and if the user then bumps the fee via RBF the wallet signs a valid payment to the attacker. Exploited in the wild with at least one confirmed loss; upgrade to 4.8.3 and check every output before signing, including fee bumps. https://pwn.watch/i/electrum-malicious-server-rbf-fee-bump-theft
> **[zh]** **Electrum 钱包：恶意服务器调包刚发出的交易，用户一加手续费就付给了攻击者**：4.8.3 之前的 Electrum 对未确认交易直接信任服务器、不验签名；恶意服务器吞掉真实广播，显示一笔假交易，收款地址被刻意碰撞成后四位一致，用户若再用 RBF 加速，钱包就会签出一笔真正付给攻击者的交易。已有在野利用、至少一人确认损失；请升级到 4.8.3，签名前（包括加速）核对每个输出地址和金额。
5. **The Verge: Google's AI search changes upended online publishing**: The Stepback recaps how AI Overviews and AI Mode broke the clicks-for-content deal — DMG Media told the UK CMA click-through fell up to 89%, Pew found people click less when an Overview appears, and lawsuits (Chegg, Penske) have mostly failed. Google now shows sources more prominently, runs a News AI licensing pilot with 400 publishers and is testing payments for content used in AI answers, while Reddit reportedly considers cutting Google off. https://www.theverge.com/column/1017983/google-ai-search-online-publishing
> **[zh]** **The Verge：Google 的 AI 搜索改变颠覆了网络出版业**：The Stepback 回顾 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 如何打破「内容换点击」的默契——DMG Media 向英国 CMA 称点击率最多降 89%，皮尤调查发现出现 AI 摘要时人们更少点链接，Chegg、Penske 等的诉讼大多失败。Google 现在把来源展示得更醒目，与 400 家媒体做 News AI 授权试点，并在测试为 AI 回答所用内容付费；另据报道 Reddit 也在考虑切断 Google。

### 中文社区
1. **V2EX 热帖：「Claude 支持中国了？」——其实只是支付页能选中国和银联**：楼主截图称 Claude 订阅页地区能选中国、支付方式能选银联；回复普遍泼冷水：这是 Stripe 的默认模板、只是支付方式支持而使用地区并不支持，需外卡银联，国内仍会封号，别「自愿送钱去被封」。https://www.v2ex.com/t/1251557
> **[en]** **V2EX hot thread: "Does Claude support China now?" — no, it's just the checkout page**: the OP's screenshot shows China selectable as a region and UnionPay as a payment method; replies pour cold water — it's Stripe's default template, payment support isn't service availability, only overseas UnionPay cards work, and accounts in mainland China still get banned, so don't volunteer money to get banned.
2. **InfoQ：Linux 基金会报告称四分之一 PR 是「AI 垃圾」，写代码快了 52%、维护者更累了**：报告《Navigating Open Source Software Development in the Generative AI Era》显示，受访者估计用生成式 AI 后写代码耗时平均降 52%；维护者估计约 25% 的 PR 属低质量「AI slop」，大型项目达 31%，59%（大型项目 69%）称贡献量增加。71% 认为 AI 降低了参与门槛，但 53% 不认为社区信任提升；只有 35% 的项目有正式 AI 贡献政策，LF 建议明确测试、文档和 AI 使用披露要求。https://www.infoq.cn/article/9TSuUDxrUSGS26XTA2yB
> **[en]** **InfoQ: Linux Foundation report says a quarter of PRs are "AI slop" — coding is 52% faster, maintainers are more tired**: the report "Navigating Open Source Software Development in the Generative AI Era" finds respondents estimate generative AI cut coding time by 52% on average; maintainers estimate ~25% of PRs are low-quality "AI slop" (31% in large projects), and 59% (69% for large projects) see more contributions. 71% say AI lowers the barrier to entry but 53% disagree that it improved community trust; only 35% of projects have a formal AI-contribution policy, and the LF recommends clear rules on testing, documentation and AI-use disclosure.
3. **36氪：信通院报告称国内大模型均价涨至约 13 元，两年价格战后近乎翻倍**：据 9 点 1 氪转引界面新闻，中国信通院人工智能所 10 月 23 日发布《大模型词元服务性能监测报告（2026 年）》：国内模型服务 2025 下半年归一化均价 6.8 元，今年以来 13.46 元，涨幅接近 1 倍；国外 2026 年以来发布的典型模型平均归一价格约 117.8 元，仍远高于国内。https://36kr.com/p/4039177193411718
> **[en]** **36Kr: CAICT report says average Chinese LLM prices have risen to ~13 yuan, nearly doubling after two years of price wars**: per 36Kr's morning brief citing Jiemian, CAICT's AI institute released its 2026 LLM token-service performance report on Oct 23: the normalized average price of domestic model services was 6.8 yuan in H2 2025 and 13.46 yuan so far this year, close to a 2x rise; typical foreign models released in 2026 average ~117.8 yuan, still far above domestic prices.
